cohort: 100 women experiencing postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) in tertiary care hospitals in Pakistan.
finding: The most common cause of PPH was uterine atony (45%), 60% of cases required blood transfusions, acute kidney injury (10%) was the most frequent urological complication, and 80% of maternal outcomes resulted in recovery.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean delivery was identified as a risk factor for PPH in 32% of cases.
